item.title: Super Bowl Soulful Celebration returns for its 26th year with music, faith, and football
item.description: The official NFL-sanctioned event, Super Bowl Soulful Celebration, is back and ready to deliver a star-studded show during the week of Super Bowl LIX. The big game will take place on Sunday, February 9, in New Orleans, where the Kansas City Chiefs will face off against the Philadelphia Eagles.

item.title: From first date to forever, Ciara and Russell Wilson’s love story continues to inspire
item.description: One of the most beloved couples in sports and entertainment is Ciara and Russell Wilson. Since their first meeting, the two have been inseparable, becoming the definition of relationship goals for many.

item.title: Marvin Sapp releases an EP of love songs entitled "If I Were an R&B Singer"
item.description: Marvin Sapp is well known for his vocal impact in the gospel industry. However Sapp’s second love is R&B. At a young age he was forced to choose a genre. His decision to sing gospel has afforded him a successful career.

item.title: Penny Proud shines louder than ever with season 3 premiere and season 4 renewal
item.description: The season 3 premiere of The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder will release on Thursday, August 6 on Disney+.The Proud Family franchise has never disappointed when it comes to featuring the biggest and brightest stars, and this season is no different. New guest stars include Janelle James, Sanaa Lathan, Neil deGrasse Tyson, Lynn Whitfield, Adrienne Warren, Kirk Franklin, and Bubba Wallace.

item.title: The Stellar Awards celebrates its ruby year with performances by Jonathan McReynolds, Pastor Mike Todd & Transformation Worship, Melvin Crispell III & more
item.description: The Stellar Gospel Music Awards celebrates 40 years of highlighting gospel music and the artists behind the melodies.Gospel Music's biggest night was filmed on August 16 in Nashville, TN at the Schermerhorn Symphony Center, and hosted by Stellar and GRAMMY Award-winning duo BeBe and CeCe Winans.

item.title: Christian music newcomer, Anthny, delivers single, "No Stages" ahead of EP release
item.description: Singer and song writer, Anthny, is bound to be Christian music's next biggest star! Anthny’s music fuses vulnerability and spiritual depth, resonating with listeners navigating the complexities of faith, identity, and purpose. Anthny's newest single, "No Stages," is fresh, relatable and real. The song comes from his upcoming debut EP titled, Diary Entry 1.

item.title: Maverick City Music hits #1 with single, "Constant" featuring Chandler Moore, Jordin Sparks and Anthony Gargiula
item.description: Maverick City Music reaches their third #1 single on the Billboard Gospel Airplay chart with "Constant" featuring Chandler Moore, Jordin Sparks and Anthony Gargiula. The single is also the highest-streaming song currently at Gospel radio, with over 30 million streams since its release.

item.title: Pastor Shirley Caesar to receive Lifetime Achievement Award at 2025 HBCU Honors
item.description: Pastor Shirley Caesar, a graduate of Shaw University, will be given the Lifetime Achievement Award at the 2025 HBCU Honors. Caesar has been impacting the world through song and messages of faith for more than 60 years, landing her the title of "First Lady of Gospel."

item.title: 7 Powerful movies and shows to watch this Resurrection Weekend
item.description: Whether you’re spending time with family, serving at church, or simply taking a moment to slow down, what you watch can set the tone. If you’re looking for something meaningful and inspiring, these movies and shows will help you focus on the true message of the weekend. Here are seven powerful picks to add to your watchlist.

item.title: Jonathan McReynolds releases new album "Closer (Live in Chicago)"
item.description: It's been three years since Jonathan McReynolds released an album, but the wait is over. The singer, song writer and musician just released his latest album titled, Closer (Live in Chicago). The 13-track project recorded in his hometown of Chicago is McReynolds' most personal and spiritually centered project to date.
